content.short: TON DNS lets users buy.ton domains and map readable names to wallets, smart contracts, and websites.
content.description: TON DNS provides human-readable.ton names for The Open Network. Users can participate in domain auctions, manage owned names, and point short names at wallets, smart contracts, or websites so TON addresses are easier to use. The product matters because it turns long technical addresses into names people can remember, share, and use across wallet flows, contract interactions, and web destinations connected to the TON ecosystem. It is a naming layer for everyday TON usability, not a custody wallet.
content.meta: TON DNS is a.ton name service for wallets, smart contracts, and websites. Discover its TON naming role on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
